subject: Quick question: do you think this convergence trend is totally OK?

messages.author: 7a97c986864bf6d6
messages.subject: Quick question: do you think this convergence trend is totally OK?
parts:
Hello community,

it is clear to me that this parameter has not converged completely. There is an oscillation of each of 8 chains. They don;t converge at the same time to a value with their mean.

From your experience does this underline a pathology of the model?




Thanks a lot.
Stefano

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Quick question: do you think this convergence trend is totally OK?
parts:
It looks like it's mixing, but not mixing quickly. What are the R-hat
and n_eff values? That's how we measure this. You may just need
more iterations. If you want to make this more efficient, you'll probably
need to reparameterize---this often comes up when two (or more)
parameters are tightly correlated in the posterior.

- Bob
